subtitle.en: Walk among the lanterns by day; let the fangs speak at midnight.
subtitle.zh: 白昼隐入灯火，子夜利爪封喉。

subtitle.en: No mystic art in hand, only clear eyes to pierce the fog.
subtitle.zh: 手中虽无奇术，明眼亦能破雾寻狼。

subtitle.en: Beneath the ink-stained moon, no mask hides its true shadow.
subtitle.zh: 水墨孤月之下，真假终见分晓。

subtitle.en: One drop mends the soul; another seals the night.
subtitle.zh: 一滴回魂续命，一滴封喉断夜。

subtitle.en: Even if I fall tonight, my final bolt never misses.
subtitle.zh: 纵使今夜倒下，最后一箭也绝不落空。

subtitle.en: Laugh at the fool if you wish—only the waking survive the crowd.
subtitle.zh: 世人笑我痴狂，唯有清醒者死里逃生。
